title: 13-Week Cash Flow Plan
description: This Actor runs as an MCP server. Connect your AI client to its Standby endpoint and ask for a cash flow plan — the fields below are only used if you run it directly.

openingBalance.title: Opening cash balance
openingBalance.description: Cash in the bank on day one.

receipts.title: Expected receipts, per week
receipts.description: Cash expected in from customers each week.

payroll.title: Payroll, per week
payroll.description: Wages and salaries. Leave empty for zero.

loanRepayments.title: Loan instalments, per week
loanRepayments.description: Loan and lease repayments. Leave empty for zero.

taxes.title: VAT and taxes, per week
taxes.description: Tax falling due. Leave empty for zero.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: First day of the plan, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

currency.title: Currency label
currency.description: Shown in the workbook header. Label only — nothing is converted.
